info.name: SAP Business ByDesign OData Analytics Sales API

description.content:
OData v2 REST API for SAP Business ByDesign — a cloud ERP solution for midmarket companies. Provides access to business objects and analytics across financials, CRM, procurement, supply chain, project management, and HR. Supports CRUD operations and custom OData services via the /sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/ namespace, plus pre-built analytics services via /sap/byd/odata/{service_name}.svc/.
